title: 🚨 YOUR PHONE MAY BE DISCIPLING YOU MORE THAN YOUR BIBLE.
paragraphs: 🚨 YOUR PHONE MAY BE DISCIPLING YOU MORE THAN YOUR BIBLE.
Read that again.
Every day, thousands of Christians spend hours scrolling...
But only minutes in God's Word.
We check notifications before prayer.
We consume content before Scripture.
We know what's trending online...
But struggle to remember what God said this morning.
And that's the problem.
Technology is not evil.
But when it controls your attention, shapes your thinking, and steals your time from God...
It becomes a spiritual battlefield.
THE CHRISTIAN GUIDE TO TECHNOLOGY
A powerful biblical guide for navigating social media, AI, screen time, distractions, digital purity, and online influence without losing your walk with God.
This is not another tech book.
This is a wake-up call for believers living in a digital world.
Inside you'll discover:
✅ How to use technology without becoming controlled by it
✅ Biblical principles for social media, AI, and digital influence
✅ How to protect your mind from constant distraction
✅ Practical strategies for redeeming your time
✅ How to glorify God online instead of feeding the flesh
✅ Digital habits that strengthen your faith instead of weakening it
✅ How Christians can use technology for Kingdom impact
🔥 MOST PEOPLE VS FEW PEOPLE
Most people let technology shape their beliefs.
Few people let Scripture shape how they use technology.
Most people consume endlessly.
Few people create eternal impact.
Most people scroll.
Few people disciple.
Most people chase attention.
Few people pursue God's purpose.
Which one are you?
⚔️ THIS IS MORE THAN A BOOK
This is part of the Gospel Warrior movement.
A growing library of biblical resources created to help believers:

• Renew their minds
• Grow in spiritual discipline
• Defeat distractions
• Strengthen their faith
• Live boldly for Christ
✔ Early access to new releases
✔ 50% OFF as a thank-you on many Gospel Warrior products including books, shirts, mugs, journals, and more
Because you want to become the kind of believer who lives intentionally in a distracted world.
If you're serious about growing in Christ...
If you're tired of wasting time...
If you're ready to honor God with every area of your life—including technology—
if you want the wisdom for it.
Let's build a generation that uses technology for God's glory instead of being controlled by it.
